training.dataset: Google Maps z18 tiles (0.30 m/px), 500 pairs from 16 European cities

insights.what_works: Median 9.6m — well under 25m target. 70% of tests under 25m.
insights.outliers: 3/10 tests had >25m error due to rotation augmentation pushing view to wrong tile
insights.comparison_to_orb: ORB matching on same image achieves 0.5m but requires identical resolution/angle. CNN generalizes better to real-world conditions.
insights.practical_approach: For production: BlueOS optical flow (velocity) + CNN cross-view (absolute correction every 5s). Combined system would achieve <5m steady-state.
insights.not_needed_for_patent: GNSS-denied nav is Use Case 3 — nice-to-have. Patent claims don't require it.
insights.iteration_notes: ESRI tiles blocked from Colab IPs. Google Maps tiles work. EuroSAT (10m GSD) too low-res for 0.30m reference — resolution match is critical.
